findings.title: Cross-process phase and helper times use incompatible monotonic origins
findings.minimal_repair: Bind an explicit shared clock and safe per-consumer local deadline conversion, or retain parent causal ordering and own-process elapsed limits with a conservative remaining phase budget. Preserve common's local-clock contract, original 120s phases and 10s commands. Do not retag old timestamps or repeat qualification.
findings.proof: Static source/interface inspection plus official CPython 3.9.6 and 3.13.9 source and Python time documentation. Target SYSTEM 3.9 is a supplied premise; no live interpreter probe.

findings.title: Raw publication error can replace an earlier collected command failure
findings.minimal_repair: Retain the active command's bounded collector status and latch already-observed failed status before raw writes. Record publication errors separately. Keep authoritative payload comparison after durable raw/status publication, retain accurate partial references, and add no retries, writer entries or late allowance.
findings.proof: Static exception flow: collect returns failed status; raw write/fsync raises before first_failed_comparison exists; main reports the writer error and retains only minimal direct-child status. No failure injection or runtime test.
